messages.author: 9d27bd84296b8a15
messages.subject: Error in fitMeasures and blavFitIndices
parts:
Hi! 

I'm getting the following error when I try to use the blavFitIndices and fitMeasures functions on my blavaan object: 

Error in fitMeasures(object, paste0("p_", pD)) : could not find symbol "fm.args" in environment of the generic function

I haven't been able to figure out a solution. 

Thanks in advance for any help or advice, and please let me know if any further information would be helpful!

Haley

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Error in fitMeasures and blavFitIndices
parts:
Hi Haley,

Thanks for the report. My first guess here is that you might have upgraded lavaan but not blavaan. I believe that lavaan recently added the "fm.args" thing, and it might need to be registered in blavaan by re-installing blavaan.

If that doesn't fix it, it would help to see the code that leads to the error, along with the sessionInfo() output.

Thanks,
Ed

Hi Ed, 

Thanks so much for your response. I tried re-installing blavaan and unfortunately the error is persisting. Here is the code I'm using as well as the output from sessionInfo(): 


my.inf.loading.priors <- dpriors(lambda="normal(1,5)") ## informative priors for factor loadings

mod.6.priors = ' # measurement model
          IQUAL2 =~ 1*Positivity_Composite_D2 + Connectedness_Fluency_D2 + Coordinated_Composite_D2 + Mutuality_D2
          IQUAL1 =~ 1*Positivity_Composite_D1 + Connectedness_Fluency_D1 + Coordinated_Composite_D1 + Mutuality_D1
         
          # structural model
          IQUAL2 ~ prior("normal(0,2)")*Condition + prior("normal(0.6,2)")*IQUAL1 + prior("normal(0.3,2)")*Digital_Media_Parent_Involvement + prior("normal(0.1,2)")*PlaySupport + prior("normal(0.1,2)")*ActiveParentRole + prior("normal(0,2)")*Digital_Media_Positive_Beliefs
         
          # allow predictors to covary
          Digital_Media_Parent_Involvement ~~ IQUAL1 + PlaySupport + ActiveParentRole + Digital_Media_Positive_Beliefs
          IQUAL1 ~~ PlaySupport + ActiveParentRole + Digital_Media_Positive_Beliefs
          PlaySupport ~~ ActiveParentRole + Digital_Media_Positive_Beliefs
          ActiveParentRole ~~ Digital_Media_Positive_Beliefs
         
          # allow residual covariances
          Positivity_Composite_D2 ~~ Positivity_Composite_D1
          Connectedness_Fluency_D2 ~~ Connectedness_Fluency_D1
          Coordinated_Composite_D2 ~~ Coordinated_Composite_D1
          Mutuality_D2 ~~ Mutuality_D1
         
          # fix covariance between trt and other predictors to zero
          Condition ~~ 0*IQUAL1
          Condition ~~ 0*Digital_Media_Parent_Involvement
          Condition ~~ 0*PlaySupport
          Condition ~~ 0*ActiveParentRole
          Condition ~~ 0*Digital_Media_Positive_Beliefs
         
          # means/intercepts
          IQUAL2 ~ 1
          IQUAL1 ~ 1
         
          Positivity_Composite_D2 ~ 0*1
          Positivity_Composite_D1 ~ 0*1
          '
mod6.bayes <- bsem(model = mod.6.priors, data = data_full,
                               dp = my.inf.loading.priors,
                               bcontrol=list(cores=4))
summary(mod6.bayes, standardized=TRUE)

fitMeasures(mod6.bayes)
## output: 
# Error in fitMeasures(mod6.bayes.newTRTprior.forPaper) : could not find symbol "fm.args" in environment of the generic function

blavFitIndices(mod6.bayes)

# Error in fitMeasures(object, paste0("p_", pD)) : could not find symbol "fm.args" in environment of the generic function

messages.subject: Re: Error in fitMeasures and blavFitIndices
parts:
I didn't see anything in the model code, but I wonder whether it helps to upgrade lavaan. The sessionInfo reports lavaan 0.6-12, but 0.6-13 came out earlier in January.

I believe that fm.args was new to 0.6-13, so I'm not quite sure why 0.6-12 would complain about it. I sometimes see this sort of thing when I have packages installed in two different directories, so that different versions of the same package are installed in different places. For example, maybe 0.6-13 already exists somewhere on your system, but 0.6-12 also exists and got loaded first.

Ed
